<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://127.0.0.1/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext;
]>
<root>
  <child>Test External DTD reference</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<root xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <xi:include href="nonexistent.xml" parse="xml">
    <xi:fallback>
      <fallback-element>XInclude Fallback Content</fallback-element>
    </xi:fallback>
  </xi:include>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root>
  <data>Processing instruction test</data>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE test [
  <!ELEMENT test ANY>
  <!ENTITY % int-ent "internal entity value">
  <!ENTITY test-ent "Expanded: %int-ent;">
]>
<test>&test-ent;</test>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (#PCDATA)>
  <!NOTATION notation-name SYSTEM "http://example.org/notation">
  <!ENTITY unparsed-ent SYSTEM "http://example.org/unparsed" NDATA notation-name>
]>
<root>Unparsed entity test</root>
```
